author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Seventy-Seven! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Imagine you're on a colony ship and wake up above a hellish ruin of a world long since fallen into madness. Imagine you're the LAST colony ship, both fleeing and carrying with you the decaying remnants of what human society has become. That's the plot for Devil Worshipping Cyberpunks 666, a zine-style game on Itch right now.  Let's dive in!

Check out the rulebook in digital  HERE:https://dwcp666.itch.io/devil-worshipping-cyberpunks-666
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 077 - Devil Workshipping Cyberpunks 666 by Zakel Tanamli
